name: design-principles
description: Design principles for maintainable, testable, decoupled code, packaged as a stack-agnostic skill for coding agents.

plugins.name: design-principles
plugins.description: Deep modules, pure core / persistent shell, detachable domain, config vs record, single chokepoint per fact, data minimization, framework vs implementation, testing shape, documentation placement and discoverability. Load before planning a feature, adding a module, reviewing a diff, or deciding where code, tests, or docs go.
